pages.text: L_Ender's Cataclysm bosses live in big arenas across the Overworld, Nether and End.$(br2)$(bold)Netherite Monstrosity$() 12,000 HP: Nether.$(br)$(bold)Ender Guardian$() 16,000 HP: walk to the altar; the floor drops you into the arena.

$(bold)Ignis$() 22,000 HP: kill the Ignited Revenants for $(bold)Burning Ashes$(), use them on the Altar of Fire. Drops $(bold)Ignitium$(): the best armour in the pack, and an Ignitium Elytra Chestplate.

$(bold)Maledictus$() 22,000 HP: right-click its grave.$(br)$(bold)The Harbinger$() and $(bold)Scylla$() 32,000 HP: their own structures.$(br)$(bold)The Leviathan$() 48,000 HP: Sunken City, Abyssal Sacrifice into the Altar of the Abyss.

$(bold)Ancient Remnant$() 75,000 HP: the hardest non-dragon fight.$(br2)Cataclysm armour has abilities on keys: $(bold)[$() ability, $(bold)]$() helmet, $(bold),$() chestplate, $(bold).$() boots.$(br2)Bosses over 50,000 HP pay raw Skill Points and are announced to the whole server.

Around the same power level, try:$(br)$(bold)Bosses'Rise$(): souls-like bosses (Infernal Dragon, Kraken and others), each one's drop unlocks the next. Bind the Dodge Roll key first.$(br)$(bold)Mowzie's Mobs$(): Barako the Sun Chief.$(br)$(bold)Born in Chaos$(): Sir Pumpkinhead, Fallen Chaos Knight, Nightmare Stalker.
